signature: HRESULT WINAPI winegstreamer_create_wma_decoder(IUnknown *outer, REFIID riid, void **out)
empirical_windows_behavior: Exported by winegstreamer.dll and imported by wmadmod.dll to instantiate CLSID_WMADecMediaObject ({2eeb4adf-4578-4d10-bca7-bb955f56320a}).
Supports COM aggregation when outer != NULL and riid == IID_IUnknown, and exposes IMFTransform, IMediaObject, and IPropertyBag on the inner/delegated object.
Accepts MSAUDIO1 (0x0160), WMAudioV8 (0x0161), WMAudioV9 (0x0162), and WMAudio_Lossless (0x0163) input media types and produces 16-bit PCM or 32-bit IEEE Float audio frames.
macos_backend_strategy: Apple AudioToolbox (AudioConverterNew / AudioFormatGetProperty) and CoreMedia (CMBlockBufferCreateWithMemoryBlock) audio frame conversion with deterministic C99 PCM/Float synthesis fallback.
